{{Recipe}}

This recipe for '''oysters kilpatrick''' was adapted and modernized from the 1881 ''Household Cyclopedia.''

== Ingredients ==

* 1 part tomato sauce
* 1 part [[Cookbook:Worcestershire Sauce|Worcestershire sauce]]
* [[Cookbook:Oyster|Oysters]], shucked and in the shell
* [[Cookbook:Bacon|Bacon]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] small
* [[Cookbook:Lemon|Lemon]] wedges

== Procedure ==

# Combine the tomato sauce and Worcestershire Sauce.
# Generously place diced bacon over the raw oysters.
# Pour the sauce over the top of the oysters and bacon.
# Fill a pan with rock salt, and nestle the oysters on top.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] the oysters at 180°C until the oysters are firm to the touch and bacon is crispy. Alternatively, the oysters can be placed under a grill with a high heat until firm and bacon is crispy.
# Serve the oysters with either lemon wedges or additional Kilpatrick sauce.
